findings.text: Unwind session initialization is available as a global routine that accepts a state record plus task registers and start frame selectors and prepares the state for iteration or marks it failed or finished.

A dedicated return probe system call entry validates that invocation arrives from the expected trampoline location and then mediates between user stack saved values and probe handling before resuming user execution.
Trampoline provider reports the location and extent to use for return probes, selecting a shared trampoline region for native 64 bit execution and a single breakpoint cell otherwise.
Return probe system call argument block holds three machine words in order corresponding to r11 cx and ax exchanged across the trampoline boundary.
Frame pointer fallback unwinding descriptor is typed as a call with stack pointer derived from base pointer plus sixteen and base pointer derived from prior stack pointer minus sixteen.
Empty unwinding descriptor is typed as a call with stack adjustment of one machine word from the stack pointer and an undefined base pointer rule.
A dedicated mutex exists alongside two globals that point at the address table and descriptor table currently being ordered, indicating serialized reordering of those paired tables.

Reordering keeps the two parallel tables consistent: entries in the address table exchange positions with correction for their relative distance and the matching descriptor entries exchange as a pair.
Ordering comparison ranks entries by decoded instruction address and, when addresses tie, places undefined typed gap fillers before genuine entries so lookup prefers genuine ones.
Diagnostic dumping of unwind state and raw stack words is one shot for the lifetime of the system. Only the first request emits output and later requests do nothing.

Start up distinguishes unready or cross processor tasks as errors, user mode register origins as immediately finished with unknown stack classification, and kernel register or current or descheduled task origins as unwindable with captured pointers.

Stack validation tolerates one overflow into a guard region by retrying at the next aligned page while still flagging an error, and the start position is advanced past the register frame or forward until the caller requested frame is reached.
Probe fixup flags use single bit values one two four eight sixteen and thirty two for address call flags and three scratch register selectors, with the combined mask covering the three selectors.
The sentinel trap number for probes is the maximum unsigned integer value.
Optimized probe sequence sizes are five for the stack address computation, that plus the call size for the whole sequence, with a red zone reservation of one hundred twenty eight.

Probability of single step emulation is encoded as bit maps over first opcode bytes separately for 32 and 64 bit modes plus a shared map for second bytes of two byte opcodes, each build selecting either a populated map or a null placeholder.

Probe eligibility rejects segment and lock prefixed operations and exception masking operations, otherwise accepting operations whose leading opcode is marked in the mode appropriate map or whose second byte is marked when two bytes are present.

Position independent memory references are rewritten to use a scratch register: prefix extension bits are normalized, an unused caller saved register is preferred in order source index then destination index then base, the choice is recorded in fixups, and addressing is converted from relative to register plus displacement.

Around out of line execution the selected scratch register is preserved in task probe storage and pointed at the end of the probed operation, then restored afterward. Selection follows the recorded fixup with base as default.
Probe trampoline file mapping is a two page special region with a fixed display name whose remap operation always refuses with a permission error.
Optimized probe sites are recognized by a stack address pattern followed by a call, including a variant where the first byte is replaced by a breakpoint while the remainder still matches.

Trampoline placement reuses an existing special region within signed 32 bit call distance of the probe site when possible, otherwise locates the closest available page above or below within that range and installs a new executable readable mapping there.
Membership testing for the trampoline region first attempts a speculative lock free address space check and on retry falls back to holding the address space read lock during lookup.

Return probe handling moves from caller authentication through user argument import and register exposure to delegated handling, then either returns directly when the stack moved or shadow execution is active or rewrites the user stack to resume via the trampoline return.

Unwinding relies on racy cross processor exclusion plus single access reads of live stack and task memory, and stack overflow is reported as erroneous yet still yields a partial trace when the neighboring page is valid.

Return probe resumption trusts user stack contents only after strict trampoline and caller checks, failing to an illegal instruction signal on mismatch or copy faults, and trampoline allocation fails cleanly when no reachable page exists or bounds are violated.
